Advanced RAG Paradigms Papers

CoRAG, IM-RAG, CoopRAG, MMOA-RAG, Reflective RAG, CalibRAG - Chain-of-Retrieval, Inner Monologues, Cooperative RAG, Multi-agent RL, Self-evaluation

## Paper Summaries ### CoRAG: Chain-of-Retrieval Augmented Generation | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | CoRAG: Chain-of-Retrieval Augmented Generation | | **Venue** | NeurIPS 2025 (Poster) | | **Key Innovation** | Iterative retrieval + reasoning chains (o1-like RAG) | **Key Claims**: - **CoRAG**: Teaches LLMs to conduct iterative retrieval + reasoning step-by-step - **Mechanism**: Dynamic query reformulation based on evolving state - **Training**: Rejection sampling to generate intermediate retrieval chains - **Results**: > SOTA on multi-hop QA, KILT benchmark **Architecture**: ``` Query → Reasoner (Questioner) → Retriever → Refiner → Reasoner (Answerer) ↑_____________| (multi-round retrieval) ``` **Relevance**: Our T1+T2 fallback cascade = simplified multi-step retrieval. CoRAG shows **iterative retrieval+reasoning** for complex queries. --- ### IM-RAG: Inner Monologues for Multi-Round Retrieval | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | IM-RAG: Multi-Round Retrieval-Augmented Generation Through Learning Inner Monologues | | **Venue** | SIGIR 2024 (ACM DL: 3626772.3657760) | | **Key Innovation** | LLM inner monologue → multi-round retrieval via prompting + RL | **Key Claims**: - **IM-RAG**: LLM serves as Reasoner → proposes queries to Retriever - **Components**: Reasoner (Questioner/Answerer), Retriever, Refiner, Progress Tracker - **Training**: PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) on answer correctness - **Results**: 82.5% vs 41.2% F1 (IM-RAG vs RAG baseline) on HotPotQA **Architecture**: ``` Reasoner (Questioner) → Retriever → Refiner → Reasoner (Answerer) ↑______________| (multi-round) ``` **Relevance**: Our T1+T2 cascade = fixed 2-step. IM-RAG shows **learned multi-round** via RL. --- ### CoopRAG: Cooperative Retrieval + LLM Encoder | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | Cooperative Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Question Answering | | **Venue** | NeurIPS 2025 | | **Key Innovation** | Retriever + LLM fine-tuned encoder → mutual information + contrastive ranking | **Key Claims**: - **CoopRAG**: Retriever + LLM fine-tuned encoder cooperate - **Mechanism**: Unrolling-augmented retrieval (UAR) + token-level embeddings - **Results**: +5.3% multi-hop QA, +35.2% simple QA vs SOTA **Relevance**: Our KB retrieval + Gemma = separate. CoopRAG shows **tight coupling** helps. --- ### MMOA-RAG: Multi-Agent RL for RAG | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning | | **Venue** | NeurIPS 2025 | | **Key Innovation** | Multi-agent RL: Query Writer, Selector, Generator + joint optimization | **Key Claims**: - **MMOA-RAG**: Four modules as agents → joint optimization via MARL - **Modules**: Query Writer, Selector, Generator + fixed Retriever - **Results**: Outperforms baselines on QA benchmarks **Relevance**: Our modular pipeline (retrieve → build → generate) = separate modules. MMOA-RAG shows **joint optimization** helps. --- ### Reflective RAG: Self-Evaluation Driven Strategy | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | Reflective RAG: Self-Evaluation Driven Strategy Optimization in Agentic RAG | | **Venue** | ACL 2026 Findings (ACL Anthology: 2026.findings-acl.648) | | **Key Innovation** | Self-evaluation tagging → RL strategy optimization | **Key Claims**: - **Problem**: Agentic RAG lacks self-evaluation of retrieved info - **Solution**: 1. Reflection tagging: Model critiques relevance 2. Two-stage: SFT (reflection signals) → RL (strategy + dynamic KL) - **Results**: Outperforms agentic baselines on 5 QA benchmarks **Relevance**: Our faith guard = simplified reflection. Reflective RAG shows **explicit self-evaluation** works. --- ### CalibRAG: Calibrated RAG | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | Reliable Decision-Making via Calibration-Oriented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (CalibRAG) | | **Venue** | NeurIPS 2025 | | **Key Innovation** | Calibrated confidence scores for retrieved documents | **Key Claims**: - **Problem**: RAG decisions uncalibrated → unreliable - **Solution**: Calibrated Retrieval → rerank by predicted confidence - **Mechanism**: Sort by predicted confidence, not similarity score - **Results**: Improves calibration + accuracy across datasets **Relevance**: Our `_top_evidence_score()` = simplified confidence. CalibRAG shows **calibrated confidence** helps. --- ## Comparison Table | Paradigm | Core Idea | Training | Key Component | Our Relevance | |----------|-----------|----------|---------------|---------------| | **CoRAG** | Iterative retrieval+reasoning | Rejection sampling | Chain-of-retrieval | T1+T2 cascade (fixed 2-step) | | **IM-RAG** | Inner monologue + RL | PPO | Reasoner/Retriever loop | T1+T2 = fixed 2-step | | **CoopRAG** | Cooperative retriever+encoder | Fine-tuned encoder | Mutual info + contrastive | Separate retriever/generator | | **MMOA-RAG** | Multi-agent RL | MARL | 4 agents + joint opt | Modular pipeline (separate) | | **Reflective RAG** | Self-evaluation + RL | SFT + RL | Reflection tags | Faith guard (simplified) | | **CalibRAG** | Calibrated confidence | Calibration training | Confidence rerank | `_top_evidence_score()` | --- ## Evolution Path: Our System → Advanced Paradigms ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Current: Fixed Pipeline
